D/ COM[--]NT[--]PM AVG BR ; R/ PIET[-- ]E[---]IM[--][--]

Silver coin. Denarius of Commodus (175-192), as kindly identified by the finder; possibly Sear vol. 2 no. 5667, citing RIC vol. 3 no. 194; if so, issue of 186-189. Obverse description: Bust laureate right, bearded with curls, ear or ram’s horn shown. Obverse inscription: COM[--]NT[--]PM AVG BR. Reverse description: two robed figures clasping hands, a small pot between figures. Reverse…
